# CranberryClock showcase signature

cranberryclock.webp is the existing portfolio header artwork supplied by reference by CranberryClock. Retrieved from https://cranberryclock.com/images/cranberry-hero-crown-v2.webp on 2026-09-09 and reused with the owner's instruction for these showcases.

Character guide: cranberry fruit with embedded antique clock face; natural pointed cranberry crown at the top. No leaves and no apple-like stem. The pink graffiti crown is a separate brand accent. The simplified Three.js cameo shows 2:15. This is showcase branding, not a dependency of any headless package.
